text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Happy New Year! I'm looking 
forward to working with you again this 
year.

The new year arrived, and Fuji Kiseki came 
to greet me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And so, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since I'll be relying on you even more 
this year, I brought a heartfelt gift for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The ultimate thrill!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, let the New Year's Talent Show 
begin~!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Sorry for the sudden invite. But 
it's a special day, and I wanted you to 
enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I put together a whole lineup for you. 
Pick whatever you like!

Fuji Kiseki was presented with three party 
tricks.
choice_data_list: In One Breath: The Medicine Peddler

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Medicine Peddler, right? Alright, 
leave it to me! I did that a ton when I 
was a kid!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phoo... *deep inhale*...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"‘Those among the gathering may well know 
of me, called the Oyakata, who set out 
from Edo twenty leagues up toward the 
capital—’"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—Though they speak of Odawara's ash 
bales, san bales, and charcoal bales, it 
was Master Ensai alone who inscribed 
'Uiro' in hiragana—"

Fuji Kiseki's recitation of The Medicine 
Peddler was blisteringly fast, yet it 
somehow still felt emotive—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—'Bow with utmost respect, is there 
anyone who desires uirou'...?!"

It was so well-crafted that I couldn't 
help clapping!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, getting applause like that makes me 
want to thank my past self!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'm gonna make a little noise, 
then!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Music, start!

Out of nowhere, "Make debut!" begins to 
play—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hup, hah!

With a mix of cartwheels, back 
handsprings, and aerial flips, an 
acrobatic "Make debut!" had begun...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah...! How was that, Trainer?

"Though 'Make debut!' carries a strong, 
adorable impression, this choreography 
completely transformed that image in an 
instant."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'm so glad to see you this happy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should involve the dorm girls and 
finish up an 18-person version too?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Understood! The umbrella spinning, right?

The umbrella-spinning Fuji Kiseki showed 
us was truly exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, whoa, whoa! Phew, that was close!

It looks like it might fall over and over, 
but it never actually drops. Skillfully 
manipulating the umbrella—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ha!

In the end, she tossed the ball high into 
the air and brought things to a close with 
a brilliant catch!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad you enjoyed it.

And so, thanks to Fuji Kiseki, I was able 
to spend a wonderful New Year.

This year will surely be a decisive one. 
Let's join forces and do our best!
